title: Preclinical evaluation of Raman spectroscopy for pedicular screw insertion surgical guidance in a porcine spine model.
summary: Raman spectra and machine learning identify bone/spinal-canal tissue interfaces during pedicle-screw drilling in a porcine spine model.
ai_technology: The study tests ex-vivo and in-vivo porcine drilling spectra; models distinguish tissue types and detect the bone/canal boundary, with >96% accuracy across six tissue classes.
organization: Princess Margaret Cancer Center, Toronto, Ontario, Canada

evidence.tested: Raman spectra and machine learning identify bone/spinal-canal tissue interfaces during pedicle-screw drilling in a porcine spine model.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
